soul_corrections.current_text: The Bearzooka is drawn as a green, hazard-striped tube [Observed; Inference].
soul_corrections.correction: The BBG Bearzooka is a coral-red tube (#A54447 on the April 2013 BBR model; #D05655 under 2026 trailer light) with a row of glowing orange window panels (#EB7921-#FEA53C; rectangular in 2013, pointed and chevron-like in 2026), grey bands, a black bore and a flared muzzle end (grey-and-red checkered on the 2026 model). It rests on his right shoulder and is about 0.8x his height [Observed]. The green, hazard-striped launcher is the BB: Zombies Bearzooka (wiki File:Bear.jpg), the likely source of this line [Observed; Inference]. The only green launchers in BBG are Tillman's yellow-olive Twin Bearzookas.
soul_corrections.evidence: Photo_19-04-13_12_02_26_PM.png (Bearzooka (BBG) infobox, 'Oliver with the Bearzooka'); Dban1 '[Oliver]:Secondary - Bearzooka' thumbnails (April 2013); 2026 trailer frames 3.9-4.4 s (t_0009); Bear.jpg ('Bearzooka in BBZ'); Ohmagawdyas.png; the wiki's 'In BBG and BB0, it is a rocket launcher with red and orange lines.'
